name: Plain Markdown folder
description: Notes you save as ordinary .md files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, a notes folder) that the agent reads with its normal file tools. It does not capture or recall anything automatically on its own.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Nothing to install: files in a folder

offline_no_account.value: Yes: just files; the agent itself still needs its own login

plain_files.value: Yes: Markdown you open and edit yourself

claude_code.value: Yes: CLAUDE.md is read at session start

codex.value: Yes: AGENTS.md is read at session start

survives_crash.value: Files on disk stay as last saved

survives_compaction.value: Project CLAUDE.md is re-read after compaction in Claude Code

undo_delete.value: Whatever your editor or git gives you
